label: Wipe member
description: Remove everything a member has in this program: their triggers (wiped, their runs cancelled), the copies of the infra nodes listed in `infra` (terminated with every disk, the ones listed in `keepOnTerminate` too), the values they gave for the `@member_filled` fields, their connections, their tokens, their files (`StorageScope::Member`), and their runs. The member id then has nothing attached; run it again to finish a wipe that stopped part way.

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

inputs.name: infra
inputs.description: The `@per_member` infra nodes whose member copy to terminate, named the way the program writes them.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: this run keeps going even when it is one of the runs reached. On: this run ends with them, cancelled.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once everything the member had is removed, except the deletion of their infra copies, which is handed to the supervisor and finishes on its own time. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.
